CCP_equipment_next_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_page < ccp_equipment_pages_last }
		}
		add_to_variable = { ccp_equipment_page = 1 }
		CCP_equipment_load_page = yes
	}
}

CCP_equipment_prev_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_page > 0 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { ccp_equipment_page = 1 }
		CCP_equipment_load_page = yes
	}
}

CCP_equipment_grant = {
	set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 14 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 1 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_infantry = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 2 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_support = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 3 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_artillery = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 4 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_anti_tank = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 5 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_anti_air = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 6 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_motorized = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 7 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_mechanized = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 8 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_armor = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 9 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_railway_gun = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 10 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_fighter = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 11 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_cas = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 12 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_naval_bomber = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 13 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_tactical_bomber = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 14 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_strategic_bomber = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 15 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_capital_ship = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 16 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_carrier = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 17 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_screen_ship = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 18 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_submarine = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 19 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_convoy = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 20 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_train = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 21 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_missile = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 22 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_special = yes
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}

CCP_equipment_grant_infantry = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 0 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_ADD_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_0 amount = var:ccp_amount }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 1 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_ADD_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {

		}

		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_ADD_TOOLTIP

CCP_equipment_grant_latest = {
	set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 14 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 1 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_infantry = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 2 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_support = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 3 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_artillery = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 4 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_anti_tank = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 5 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_anti_air = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 6 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_motorized = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 7 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_mechanized = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 8 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_armor = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 9 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_railway_gun = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 10 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_fighter = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 11 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_cas = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 12 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_naval_bomber = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 13 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_tactical_bomber = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 14 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_strategic_bomber = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 15 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_capital_ship = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 16 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_carrier = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 17 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_screen_ship = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 18 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_submarine = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 19 }
		}

	else_if = {

		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_train = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 21 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_missile = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_category = 22 }
		}
		CCP_equipment_grant_latest_special = yes
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}

CCP_equipment_grant_latest_infantry = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 0 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_LATEST_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_3 amount = var:ccp_amount }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 1 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_LATEST_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_3 amount = var:ccp_amount }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 2 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_LATEST_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_3 amount = var:ccp_amount }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 3 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_LATEST_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_3 amount = var:ccp_amount }

			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = sam_missile_equipment_1 amount = var:ccp_amount }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_equipment_selected = 262 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = CCP_EQUIPMENT_LATEST_TOOLTIP
		hidden_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = guided_missile_equipment_3 amount = var:ccp_amount }
			set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 5 }
		}
	}
}
